svg.aria-label: CASTAWAY: a Commodore 64 style one-screen intro
svg.title: CASTAWAY: ten hours of almost nothing
svg.desc: A Commodore 64 style one-screen intro for Castaway, a lo-fi island video: a raster-striped CASTAWAY logo, PRESENTS, TEN HOURS OF ALMOST NOTHING. on a pink raster bar, STRANDED ON 01/10/26 BY SEED 1992 on a blue one, an info block (RUNTIME 10:00:00, ACTIVITIES 90 PLUS, PLOT MINIMAL, SIGNAL ONE BAR), her island and a shark in headphones nodding on the beat, PRESS SPACE TO KEEP WAITING, EVERY SOUND IS SYNTHESIZED FROM CODE, and a scroller that opens with WELCOME TO CASTAWAY!
